characters.description: Glamorous Single Mother: While this show does a better job showing both sides, it still glamorizes part of Amy's experience by providing her a new car, a job, and countless other opportunities. It's a very white, upper-class perspective of teen pregnancy, when you consider less than half of teen moms graduate high school and only 2% graduate college by age 30. Mama Bear: When she catches Adrian holding John. Teen Pregnancy: She becomes pregnant at 15, setting off the series conflict. Abusive Parents: His abusive dad serves as his Freudian excuse. Friends with Benefits: With Adrian.

characters.description: Amicable Exes: She tries to be this after separating from her husband George. Fiery Red Head: She has red hair and hair-trigger temper when angered. Last Het Romance: After separating from her cheating husband of 20 years, she realizes she's a lesbian. Lipstick Lesbian:As of the final season, Anne comes out as a lesbian and is more feminine looking than the woman she connects with. Mama Bear: She and her ex-husband both despise "deadbeat drummer" Ricky Underwood for impregnating their daughter Amy and want to hurt him for what he did.
